Definition: to light upon (chiefly by accident); causatively, to bring about; specifically, to impose timbers (for roof or floor)
BiblicalUsage: To light upon is the word for what happens by chance: Abraham's servant prays, send me good speed this day, and meet me with the right maid; Ruth's hap was to light on a part of the field belonging to Boaz; and the Preacher says time and chance happeneth to them all.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word is honest about how life feels, and still trusts that the chance is in God's hand.
